compute.hardware: Apple local CPU; MPS detected but intentionally unused for the smoke test

deviations: The initial Census-export AnnData had generic CELLxGENE schema only (no HLCA ann_level_3/ann_level_4, smoking_status, or BMI). The final canonical inventory therefore uses the official CZI H5AD URL recorded in that Census catalogue; it retains adata.raw.X and the complete HLCA metadata.

Zenodo API delivery stalled during the 2.3 GB embedding transfer. The same official Zenodo record, filename, and byte length were retrieved through resumable 8 MiB HTTP ranges; source content, model, seed, epochs, and analysis scope were unchanged.
One of 107 donor IDs has no parseable age (3,427 cells); all donor rows remain in donors.csv and age-stratified tables use the 106 donors with a stated numeric age.

metrics.hlca_source: CZ CELLxGENE Census 2025-11-08 catalogue plus CZI full-metadata core H5AD; Zenodo record 7599104 reference assets

observations: The canonical CZI H5AD contains 584,944 cells, 107 donor IDs, raw counts at adata.raw.X with 27,402 genes, and the HLCA-specific ann_level_3, ann_level_4, smoking_status, BMI, anatomical_region_ccf_score, assay, and dataset fields.
age_or_mean_of_age_range is numeric for 581,517 cells and was selected over less complete alternative age fields; observed donor ages range from 10.0 to 76.0 years.

There are 48 age-annotated donors younger than 45 years and 17 aged 60 years or older; six studies have donors on both sides of that contrast, and 70 pooled annotation-level/cell-type rows have at least 200 cells on both sides.

The scArches surgery smoke test mapped 5,000 Banovich_Kropski_2020 cells for 20 CPU epochs through SCANVI.prepare_query_anndata plus SCANVI.load_query_data; 858,156 frozen reference parameters had maximum absolute change 0.0.
The inventory supports a young-only reference with older queries mapped in, within-study younger-versus-older contrasts, and age as a continuous covariate. H01 does not select among these designs.
suggestions: In H02, choose the primary human design before any fit and state how the one donor without a parseable age is excluded from age-based analyses.
In H02, pre-specify treatment of study, smoking, anatomical region, assay, sex, and BMI because all are present and their distributions are tabulated by age bin in confounds.csv.
Consider a within-study contrast sensitivity analysis for the six qualifying studies, because this design limits broad study-level age confounding while preserving cell-type eligibility information.
